summary: Escambia County, Alabama tower with a 12x12-foot cab, built in the 1930s and removed around 1980; the register is the only source found.

facts.status_note: Removed around 1980 per the register; no source read describes what remains at the site

events.note: Registered January 16, 2016, nominated by Al Pelham

evidence.supports: built in the 1930s and removed around 1980
evidence.quote: It was built in the 1930s and removed circa 1980.

evidence.supports: page photo credited to Al Pelham

notes_for_editor: Single source: the Former Fire Lookout Sites register. Two web searches found no other record of a tower at this site. The register gives only a decade for the build (1930s), so no built event is recorded. The register describes a tower with a 12x12-foot cab; the record's kind 'unknown' could be updated to tower, but that is a gap, not a clear error, so no correction is proposed. A Forest Lookouts page for this site was not found in the cache or on the guessed URL (404). The Open Pond Fire Tower in Conecuh National Forest is a different tower (US tower #97, CCC 1938-39) and is not used. No photo URL was extracted.
